evidence.text: The Iron Threshold repeats the selected route measurements on the selected path after intervention, during the current attempt. It also records the supplied endpoint service test as a separate cross-layer observation. The known NQ test pattern is compared only through the current physical path; a matched two-byte highlight is not a whole-frame or universal error check. Arrival at the balcony, a lit link lamp or an old pass is insufficient.

The Steady Light requires every scoped physical check, fresh link measurements, a passing endpoint service test, the defect removed and no temporary dependency. The Borrowed Dawn requires the same fresh passing service checks with a declared temporary dependency, limitation and follow-up. The Honest Shutdown requires a named unresolved defect, intentional isolation and a recovery plan; service remains unresolved. Hints do not downgrade a valid outcome.

illustrationBindings.alt: Two validation cards lie side by side. The older card has a folded corner and a broad hatched band. The newer card has a clean edge and a circular seal.
